title: POST /tournaments/:id/sync response
description: One answer per entry, in order. `saved` and `refused` are final; `retry` means ask again later (the entry stays queued). `pending` (contract revision 6, only while the tournament is run from a laptop through the cloud relay, docs/design-cloud-relay.md): the result reached the server and waits for the laptop to decide (from revision 7 an incident does too: it is logged once the laptop has logged it, photo and all); keep the entry and ask again, as for retry, and the answer turns saved or refused once the laptop has spoken. A refused `conflict` also carries `current`, what the board holds now, for "keep theirs / use mine".

reason.description: Why, as a code (e.g. conflict, no_board, revoked, rate_limited). On a tournament run from a laptop through the cloud relay: relay_stopped (the laptop stopped relaying, or handed the tournament back, before it got to the entry: tell the arbiter) and, from contract revision 9, laptop_lost (the tournament was taken back on this server without the laptop, which never read the entry: it is kept here for the arbiter to enter or dismiss, so do not send it again; show the message and let the board say what became of it).

message.description: A sentence for the person holding the phone.

current.description: Only on a refused conflict: what the board holds now (an empty string for no result), so the app can offer keep theirs or use mine. Null when the server only remembers refusing it (a resend).
